Search variables, indicators and harmonized variables

Source: R/search.R
bdhs_search.Rd

One search box for everything bundled with the package: variable names and labels of the DHS recode files (bdhs_codebook), official indicator ids, labels and definitions (bdhs_indicator_catalog), the indicators bdhs can compute from microdata (bdhs_indicator_list(), used by bdhs_estimate()) and the cross-round harmonized variables used by bdhs_harmonize(). Works offline and needs no microdata.

Usage

bdhs_search(
  pattern,
  where = c("all", "variables", "indicators", "computable", "harmonized"),
  survey = NULL,
  recode = NULL,
  value_labels = FALSE
)

Arguments

pattern

A regular expression, matched case-insensitively. Invalid regular expressions are matched as plain text.

where

Where to search: "all" (default), or any of "variables", "indicators" (official DHS indicators), "computable" (indicators bdhs_estimate() computes) and "harmonized".

survey

Optional survey references (see bdhs_survey_id()); keeps results available in at least one of these rounds.

recode

Optional recode codes (e.g. "IR", "KR"); restricts variables and harmonized variables to these recodes. Indicators are not affected.

value_labels

If TRUE, also search the value labels of variables (e.g. "pentavalent" finds variables with such a category).

Value

A tibble of class bdhs_search with columns source ("variable", "indicator", "computable" or "harmonized"), id (variable name, DHS indicator id, bdhs indicator id or harmonized name), label, recode and surveys (comma separated survey ids). For computable indicators the DHS indicator id they reproduce is appended to the label. It prints compactly; use print(x, n = Inf) to see every match or tibble::as_tibble() for a plain tibble.

See also

bdhs_variable() for one variable across rounds, bdhs_official() for the official estimates of an indicator.

Examples

bdhs_search("stunt")
#> # bdhs search for "stunt": 5 matches
#> 
#> ── Official DHS indicators (2) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> CN_NUTS_C_HA3  Children severely stunted  1996-97, 1999-00, 2004, 2007, 2011, 2014, 2017-18, 2022
#> CN_NUTS_C_HA2  Children stunted           1996-97, 1999-00, 2004, 2007, 2011, 2014, 2017-18, 2022
#> 
#> ── Computable with bdhs_estimate() (2) ─────────────────────────────────────────
#> nt_stunting         Stunting (height-for-age < ...  1996-97, 1999-00, 2004, 2007, 2011, 2014, 2017-18, 2022
#> nt_stunting_severe  Severe stunting (height-for...  1996-97, 1999-00, 2004, 2007, 2011, 2014, 2017-18, 2022
#> 
#> ── Harmonized variables (1) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> stunted_who  Stunted (WHO HAZ < -2)  all 9 DHS rounds
bdhs_search("region|division", where = "variables", recode = "IR")
#> # bdhs search for "region|division": 5 matches
#> 
#> ── Variables (5) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> v024 [IR]     division                        2017-18, 2022
#> v101 [IR]     division                        2017-18, 2022
#> v105a [IR]    division of previous residence  2017-18, 2022
#> v139 [IR]     de jure region of residence     2017-18, 2022
#> awfactr [IR]  all woman factor - regional     2017-18, 2022
bdhs_search("anemia", where = "indicators", survey = 2011)
#> # bdhs search for "anemia": 10 matches
#> 
#> ── Official DHS indicators (10) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> CN_ANMC_C_ANY  Children with any anemia                     2011
#> CN_ANMC_C_MLD  Children with mild anemia                    2011
#> CN_ANMC_C_MOD  Children with moderate anemia                2011
#> CN_ANMC_C_SEV  Children with severe anemia                  2011
#> AN_ANEM_W_ANY  Women with any anemia                        2011
#> AN_ANEM_W_MLD  Women with mild anemia                       2011
#> AN_ANEM_W_MOD  Women with moderate anemia                   2011
#> AN_ANEM_W_SEV  Women with severe anemia                     2011
#> CN_ANMC_C_NUM  Number of children under age 5               2011
#> CN_ANMC_C_UNW  Number of children under age 5 (unweighted)  2011
